name: Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges with Garlicky Parsley-Tahini Sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and cut each sweet potato lengthwise into 6-8 wedges, depending on size, then transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway through, until potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a blender. (Alternatively, you can prepare the sauce using a food processor.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Peel garlic. Add to the blender along with tahini, water, and salt. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency.
Divide sweet potato wedges between plates. Serve with tahini sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
